premises.text: Satellites today have only one tank of fuel and must be destroyed when that fuel runs out
premises.evidence_span: that is the reality that we live with in the space industry today

premises.text: Tanks flown on available launch vehicles plus orbital logistics deliver the right fuel to customers when needed
premises.evidence_span: We build tanks, we put them onto any available launch vehicle so we get the best deal putting them into space

premises.text: A drop-in fueling port with self-aligning arms enables safe, reliable on-orbit refueling without expensive robotic attendants
premises.evidence_span: This fueling port allows satellites to be refueled safely and reliably in orbit

premises.text: Customers can save about half of capital expenditure while the supplier earns high gross margins
premises.evidence_span: Our customers can save 50 percent on their capital expenditure, and we take home gross margins of 90 percent

premises.text: An industry-standard fueling port developed with many companies drives rapid customer adoption
premises.evidence_span: we worked with 20 companies to develop a standard fueling port

value.text: Satellites keep operating and earning instead of being thrown away when fuel runs out
value.evidence_span: It is time to stop throwing satellites away

secondary_value.text: Recover billions of dollars of lost satellite revenue
secondary_value.evidence_span: opportunity to recover billions of dollars of lost revenue

causal_links.evidence_span: Because this is a drop-in replacement, we're getting rapid customer adoption
had to be destroyed because they've run out of fuel
satellites to be refueled safely and reliably in orbit
save 50 percent on their capital expenditure

notes: Fluid-behavior and robotic-arm demo details folded into P3. ISS water resupply, Air Force/IHI/Lockheed deals, and unit shipments excluded as traction. Founder bios excluded per §4.2. 'Key to the solar system' treated as vision (v1.3.2 §4.1(4)). Singletons D1 and D3 retained as independently revisable problem and economics modules.
